thread:
oncall-maya: Pager triggered - elevated error-rate for model family gpt-eco-1 in prod. Spikes in token errors and 503s on hosted routes. Observed RPM ~1200 (baseline ~400), error-rate ~6%.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-48 created (P1) - paging oncall channel, notifying SRE/Runtime.

sre-lisa: ack. Pulling traces & pod metrics now. Any known deploys?

eng-runtime-nikhil: no recent deploys. Early signs point to KV cache pressure + long-tail request combos causing memory pressure on inference workers. Autoscaler not adding nodes because of per-tenant capacity caps.

oncall-maya: Customers affected: AcmeCorp (dedicated route), FastCart (hosted pinned), MedInsights (hosted). Can we do per-model live mitigation (throttle/quota) while we investigate?

infra-ops: We have per-model RPM/TPM controls; can change at runtime. Also option to route non-enterprise traffic to quantized variant gpt-eco-1-quant.

eng-runtime-nikhil: Proposed immediate mitigations (short-term):
- Lower hosted RPM for gpt-eco-1 from 1000 -> 300, TPM proportionally from 6000 -> 1200.
- Add routing rule: non_enterprise traffic -> gpt-eco-1-quant (less memory).
- Disable streaming for gpt-eco-1 for now (to reduce KV churn) for non-SLA customers.

Command I will run (rbctl):
```
rbctl quota update --model gpt-eco-1 --rpm 300 --tpm 1200 --scope hosted --reason "mitigate KV pressure/503s"
rbctl route add --from gpt-eco-1 --to gpt-eco-1-quant --match "!enterprise" --priority 50
rbctl feature toggle --model gpt-eco-1 --feature streaming --off --match "!enterprise" --reason "reduce KV churn"
```

oncall-maya: running the quota update now (will post outputs).

deploy-bot: command executed by oncall-maya: rbctl quota update --model gpt-eco-1 --rpm 300 --tpm 1200 --scope hosted --reason "mitigate KV pressure/503s"

oncall-maya: rbctl output: OK -> quota applied (gpt-eco-1) scope=hosted rpm=300 tpm=1200. Route add OK. Feature toggle OK.

customer-success-jordan: starting targeted outreach to AcmeCorp / FastCart / MedInsights. I'll use the incident template and note degraded throughput and mitigation steps.

ryan: good call. I'll standby for handoff at 23:00 UTC. Please document exact commands and rationale in the incident thread.

sre-lisa: initial metric check (5m after change): 503s down 70% cluster-wide for gpt-eco-1, error-rate down to ~1.8%, effective hosted RPM dropped to ~320. Latency P95 improved slightly but still elevated for >1024 token requests.

eng-runtime-nikhil: confirming: throttle reduced client-perceived throughput but kept low-latency requests healthy. Autoscaler still blocked by quota caps for a subset of dedicated tenants; working with infra to temporarily raise node cap for the cluster handling AcmeCorp.

infra-ops: increased node cap for cluster-eco-a by +2 nodes (temporary) to allow autoscaler to add capacity for dedicated tenants.

oncall-maya: customer-success-jordan, did you get acknowledgment from AcmeCorp?

customer-success-jordan: AcmeCorp replied - seeing fewer 503s, asking for ETA on full recovery. Told them we expect to reassess in 2 hours and will dial quotas up slowly if stable.

eng-runtime-nikhil: plan: keep current throttles for 1.5-2 hours, monitor SLOs + KV miss rate. If stable, increase RPM to 500, TPM to 2500 for hosted, and selectively remove streaming toggle for traffic segments that are low-memory.

sre-lisa: add a watch on long-context latencies and queue depth. I'll put an alert if latency p95 for >1024 tokens > 3.5s.

oncall-maya: documenting mitigation timeline: 1763456789 apply throttle -> 1763456840 route + toggle -> reassess 2h -> handoff to ryan at 1763464800 (23:00 UTC).

ryan: acknowledged. I'll pick up and either keep throttles or escalate to rollback depending on trends. If we see customer critical impact (AcmeCorp SLA), we'll raise AcmeCorp-specific RPM temporarily and set a safety guard.

eng-runtime-nikhil: note: we'll prepare a rollback command if the throttles cause unacceptable customer degradation:
```
rbctl quota update --model gpt-eco-1 --rpm 1000 --tpm 6000 --scope hosted --reason "rollback - mitigation caused customer impact"
rbctl route remove --from gpt-eco-1 --to gpt-eco-1-quant --match "!enterprise"
rbctl feature toggle --model gpt-eco-1 --feature streaming --on --match "!enterprise"
```

customer-success-jordan: I've asked AcmeCorp to escalate if they see regression. FastCart and MedInsights acknowledged. All three requested postmortem.

sre-lisa: adding a post-incident task: add automatic per-model quota guardrails that recommend autoscale margin and prevent applying throttles that would violate SLA buckets without an explicit override.

incident-bot: Handoff scheduled: oncall-maya -> ryan at 1763464800. Incident INC-20260315-48 status: mitigation in place, monitoring.

oncall-maya: final: will keep monitoring dashboard pinned, will add runbook notes to incident ticket. Thanks team, handing off to ryan in 10m.

ryan: taking over. I have the commands and will keep the throttles until we see stable metrics for 2 hours or until runtime pushes autoscaler patch. I'll update thread with any changes. :thumbsup:

sre-lisa: thanks. We'll write a short postmortem and include exact timings and impact.

customer-success-jordan: posted customer notifications and follow-ups.

oncall-maya: closing live mitigation window for my watch.

end of thread.
